mapper.select: SELECT c.COURSE_ID AS courseId, c.TITLE AS title, c.SUBTITLE AS subtitle, c.DURATION AS duration, c.THEME AS theme, c.HERO_IMAGE AS heroImage, l.L_DONG_SIGNGU_NM AS regionName FROM COURSE c LEFT JOIN LDONG l ON c.REGION = l.L_DONG_SIGNGU_CD WHERE c.ACTIVE_YN = 'Y' ORDER BY c.COURSE_ID ASC

SELECT tp.TITLE FROM COURSE_DAY cd JOIN COURSE_PLACE cp ON cd.COURSE_DAY_ID = cp.COURSE_DAY_ID JOIN TOUR_PLACE tp ON cp.PLACE_ID = tp.CONTENT_ID WHERE cd.COURSE_ID = #{courseId} ORDER BY cd.DAY_NO ASC, cp.PLACE_ORDER ASC LIMIT 5
